Definition: Unique synthetic event record ID
Fictional member ID; joins to the Member Key
Notes: M1001-M1004 are the four anchor personas (Linda, Michael, Sarah, James). v1 marked this 'No'.

Definition: Order of the event within the member's timeline (1 = earliest)
Notes: Rows are already sorted by member, then time.

Definition: Fictional date and time of the event (Pacific)
Notes: v1 marked this 'No' even though the kit tells teams to sort by it. Window: 2026-08-31 to 2026-10-30. Branch events fall in branch hours; Contact Center events 7am-8pm.

Definition: Day of week of the event
Notes: Useful for showing that a hold placed Friday night may not be reviewed until Monday.

Definition: Group the event type belongs to
Notes: See Allowed Values.

Definition: Activity represented by the record
Notes: Controlled list of 37 values (see Allowed Values). Each type has fixed rules: e.g. Login never carries an amount; Debit Purchase is always Debit Card.

Definition: Where the event happened
Notes: Adds ATM/Card (card and ATM activity) and Back Office (system or fraud-operations actions with no member-facing channel).

Definition: Links every row about the same payment (initiated, warned, held, released, cancelled, recovered)
Notes: Blank for events not tied to a payment.

Definition: Payment method for the linked payment
Notes: 'Not Applicable' when no payment is involved (v1 put rails on logins and alerts).

Definition: Dollar amount of the linked payment or deposit; 0.00 when none
Notes: Every row about the same payment carries the same amount. Funds Recovered rows carry the amount returned.

Definition: Direction of funds
Notes: Adds Incoming (paychecks, benefits, recovered funds).

Definition: ID of the payee/recipient
Useful for Prototype?: Yes - repeat payments to same payee
Notes: Blank when no recipient applies (e.g. cash).

Definition: New = recipient added 30 days ago or less; Existing = older
Notes: Now derived from recipient_age_days, so the two always agree.

Definition: Days since the recipient was added
Notes: v1 marked this 'No'; it is the core new-recipient signal.

Definition: Days since the member last completed an outgoing payment on the same rail; blank = no prior use on record
Notes: Replaces the kit's promised 'transaction history comparisons'. Includes history from before the data window.

Definition: Payment amount divided by the member's 12-month 90th-percentile outgoing payment
Notes: Blank for rows without an outgoing payment.

Definition: Band of amount_to_baseline_ratio: Typical <= 1.5x; Above Typical <= 4x; Significantly Above Typical > 4x
Notes: Now computed, not random. v1 labeled $150 debit purchases 'Significantly Above' and $11K scam wires 'Typical'.

Definition: Number of non-card payments the member initiated in the trailing 7 days, relative to their usual weekly count
Notes: Low <= usual+1; Medium <= usual+3; High above that. 'Not Applicable' for rows without an outgoing payment.

Definition: Member's available balance after the event (completed transactions only)
Useful for Prototype?: Yes - share of balance at risk
Notes: Lets teams see an account being drained.

Definition: Yes if an email, phone, or address change occurred in the 30 days up to and including this event
Notes: Now computed in time order. v1 flagged changes before they happened.

Definition: Yes if a password reset occurred in the 7 days up to and including this event
Notes: Now computed in time order. Does not include device intelligence.

Definition: Whether the member has a trusted contact on file at the time of the event
Notes: Changes to Yes after a Trusted Contact Enrolled event. A trusted contact has no account authority.

Definition: Yes only on Warning Displayed rows
Notes: Teams should improve beyond a generic warning; see event_note for the warning type shown.

Definition: What the member did when asked or warned
Notes: Confirmed Intended; Cancelled Payment; Reported Not Me; Requested Help; Accepted Offer; Declined Offer; Not Asked.

Definition: Whether an employee took part in this event
Notes: Branch, Contact Center, or back-office fraud staff.

Definition: Whether the member has an open fraud/scam case at the time of the event
Notes: Yes from Case Created until Case Closed. A case does not imply a confirmed fraud decision.

Definition: Status of the linked payment after this event
Notes: Pending, Held, Completed, Cancelled by Member, Stopped by Sound, Not Applicable. v1 never used Held and marked every initiated payment Completed.

Definition: Short plain-English context for scripted events (e.g. what an employee asked, where a confirmation was sent)
Example: Text sent to the phone number on file BEFORE the change
Notes: Human-observed context, not a machine signal. Blank for routine events.
